<thought>We have the CIF content for the bulk Cu₂O structure. I will call the enumerate_slabs_text tool, providing the CIF string (with newline characters escaped as \\n) and using the default Miller index (1,1,1) and default slab/vacuum sizes. The tool will return a JSON dictionary describing all possible slab terminations, which I will then save to slabs.json and report its path.</thought>
<action>enumerate_slabs_text</action>
